description: An app checkout that persists credentials or fetches submodules is rejected.

patches.find:
- checkout: app
            path: s/app
            fetchDepth: 1
            fetchTags: false
            submodules: false
            lfs: false
            persistCredentials: false
patches.replace:
- checkout: app
            path: s/app
            fetchDepth: 1
            fetchTags: false
            submodules: recursive
            lfs: false
            persistCredentials: true
